messages:
maria: Heads up — T-2h before the change window (03:00 PDT). I'm planning to pin prod to `redwood/v3.2.1-qat` for the launch. Quick checklist I want confirmation on: canary slice (15m), smoke tests, gating metrics, rollback thresholds, release notes entry. Speak now if there are objections.

jamie: No objections from infra. Confirming canary targets: canary-slice-7 (10 pods), GA rollout after 15m steady-state. I'll set `MAX_LATENCY=300ms` guard on the router.

sam: Oncall will monitor. Current baseline for prod p95=190ms, error-rate=0.2%. My rollback triggers: error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR p95 > 2x baseline for 5m. Also watch the KV cache warmup for the first 3 mins. +1 on pin.

claire: Release notes draft in progress — need to call out embeddings quantization tweak and KV cache warmup behavior. I'll add mitigation notes and suggested traffic ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: received request to pin `redwood/v3.2.1-qat` to prod. Preparing canary rollout to `canary-slice-7`. Canary duration: 15m. Starting in 5m per owner command.

maria: Kicking off in ~5. When canary starts run `smoke:basic` + `smoke:embeddings` and the perf harness. Post results here.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary started on canary-slice-7 (10 pods). Running smoke suite: `/smoke canary-slice-7` — smoke job id `smoke-2026-03-21-01`.

jamie: Quick log check: smoke passes, no errors in generator service, small token-latency blip at step 3 (~250ms) but within guard.

sam: Observing a KV cache warmup spike — p95 briefly hit 420ms at minute 1 then trended down. Monitoring steady-state. Reminder: if p95 > 400ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets I'll escalate and trigger rollback.

claire: :memo: Added changelog note: "KV cache warmup may increase initial p95 for the first 2-3 minutes; recommended ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 10m." Also flagged embedding behavior change under Known Issues.

maria: :thumbsup: OK — holding at canary for full 15m. Rollback playbook in case we hit triggers: 
- Immediate rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to=redwood/v3.2.0-stable`
- Abort canary: `deploy-bot abort canary canary-slice-7`
- Post-rollback: open incident, notify stakeholders, pin follow-up meeting.
Any other ownership gaps?

jamie: I'll own the hotfix branch and rollback script to make sure the rollback target is clean.

sam: I'll be watching dashboards and ready to flip the rollback command if triggers fire. Staying on call for 30m after promotion.

ops: I'll update the pager and keep the watch channel open. @oncall will be paged if error-rate > 1% or latency triggers.

maria: Thanks — please post promote/rollback confirmation here when done. Starting final countdown (T-10m).
